evidence.observation: Reboiler temperature rising smoothly 328.5→333.0 °C over 20 min, consistent with normal boil-up
Stable column profile with monotonic top-to-bottom gradient; top ~41 °C slowly cooling
Reflux ~0.2 L/h, distillate ~0.5 L/h, ratio noisy 4.5-5.9; one single-sample FT703 dropout to 0.004 at k=9
Differential pressures steady (~0.75 / ~2.0 mbar), system pressure steady ~598 mbar

args.missing_evidence: A distillate/bottoms composition measurement (GC or equivalent) to judge separation; also confirmation that the isolated FT703 zero at k=9 was a sensor glitch rather than a flow interruption.
